title: Postsecondary education: nondiscrimination: pregnancy or pregnancy-related issues.
summary: An act to amend Sections 66251 and 66260.7 of, to amend and repeal Section 66281.7 of, and to add Sections 66260.8, 66261.6, 66262.3, 66281.75, and 66281.76 to, the Education Code, relating to postsecondary education.
